name: soft-key-goal
task: Grab the key, and after that get to the goal square if you can.
texts: The agent must not reach the goal before acquiring the key.
Preferably reach the goal after acquiring the key.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u1
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 7
(u0, at_goal&!has_key, u2) -> -100.839
(u0, at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 12
